physics_goals.value: Search for the top quark and study QCD and two-photon physics at TRISTAN energies

summary.plain: The first international collaboration at KEK, with physicists from the United States, Japan, China and South Korea, led by Steven Olsen of Rochester. Its detector at the TRISTAN collider used a 3-tesla superconducting solenoid and, with VENUS and TOPAZ, tested QCD and searched for the top quark from 1987 to 1995.
summary.technical: AMY at TRISTAN: collaboration led by S. Olsen (Rochester) of physicists from the US, Japan, China and South Korea, the first KEK-based international collaboration; 3 T superconducting solenoid; TRISTAN programme May 1987 - December 1995.
